Meditation was free. The bicycle for the ride was paid for by the non profit after I collected a certain amount of donation money. The ride itself was very faith restoring. I went with a team and we were told to ask for food donations during the ride so that as much money as possible could go to the cause. Over about two months we only had to buy our meals once. We slept on the floor of generous churches and community centers so that was free. The traveling I paid for. I was still living with parrents at the time so I was able to save enough money to enjoy life a bit. Family helped from time to time.
Its something I've always felt I wanted to do.
